The Sheaffer VFM Rollerball Pen is designed for those who appreciate refined craftsmanship, reliable performance, and contemporary aesthetics. With its modern profile that makes a statement, this premium rollerball pen blends timeless elegance with everyday practicality. Whether you are signing important documents, taking notes, or gifting a luxury writing instrument, the Sheaffer VFM Rollerball Pen delivers unmatched style and comfort.

Crafted for smooth, effortless writing, the features advanced ink technology that ensures consistent ink flow and a flawless writing experience. The balanced weight and ergonomic grip allow for extended use without fatigue, making it an ideal choice for professionals, students, and enthusiasts alike.

Whether carried in a pocket, notebook, or case, the stands out as a symbol of refined taste and modern sophistication.

Every authentic proudly features the Sheaffer White Dot, the globally recognized trademark symbol of writing excellence. When you choose a with the White Dot, you are investing in a trusted legacy of precision engineering and superior writing performance. It assures authenticity, premium quality, and a writing instrument designed to last.

Smooth Rollerball Writing Performance

The offers the fluid writing feel of a fountain with the convenience of a rollerball. Its high-quality rollerball refill delivers bold, clean lines with minimal pressure, making it perfect for daily writing tasks, business meetings, journaling, and creative work. Designed for reliability, the ink dries quickly and resists smudging, ensuring neat and professional results every time. This makes the an excellent choice for left-handed writers as well.

Perfect Gift Presentation
